entries.name: Penthouse
entries.description: by Jonas Ohlsson generates critical-path CSS

entries.name: Critical
entries.description: by Addy Osmani generates & inlines critical-path CSS (uses Penthouse, Oust and inline-styles)

entries.name: CriticalCSS
entries.description: by FilamentGroup finds & outputs critical CSS

entries.name: mod_pagespeed
entries.description: Apache module for automatic PageSpeed optimization

entries.name: ngx_pagespeed
entries.description: Nginx module for automatic PageSpeed optimization

entries.name: critical-css-casperjs
entries.description: CasperJS script to pull critical CSS information from pages

entries.name: dr-css-inliner
entries.description: PhantomJS script to inline above-the-fold CSS on a page.

entries.name: inline-styles
entries.description: by Max Ogden, replaces <link> tags with inline <style> tags + inlines CSS url() calls with data URIs

entries.name: gulp-inline-source
entries.description: by Filip Malinowski, replaces <link> tags with inline <style> tags, and replaces <script src=""> tags with their inline content

entries.name: inline-critical
entries.description: by Ben Zörb, inline critical path CSS and load existing stylesheets with loadCSS

entries.name: isomorphic-style-loader
entries.description: for Webpack - allows to extract critical CSS for any given page/screen in React apps and inline it into HTML during server-side rendering (SSR). See React Starter Kit as an example.

entries.name: loadCSS
entries.description: loads CSS asynchronously using JS. Research that led to this is also available.

entries.name: async & conditional loading
entries.description: POC script for loading CSS files asynchronously and conditionally based on body tag classes

entries.name: asyncLoader
entries.description: async script/stylesheet loader

entries.name: basket.js
entries.description: async script/resource loader with support for localStorage caching. Can be extended to load stylesheets.

entries.name: Snippet
entries.description: by Paul Kinlan. Patrick Hamann has an exercise using the snippet you can try out.

entries.name: Snippet
entries.description: by Scott Jehl

entries.name: CSSVacuum
entries.description: by ndreckshage

entries.name: PageSpeed Insights
entries.description: Online tool that measures the performance of a page for mobile devices and desktop devices. It fetches the url twice, once with a mobile user-agent, and once with a desktop-user agent.

entries.name: PSI
entries.description: Node module for PageSpeed Insights reporting as part of your build process. Use directly with Gulp or use grunt-pagespeed if a Grunt user. For local testing, a write-up using this task and ngrok is available.

entries.name: PageSpeed Insights DevTools extension
entries.description: Chrome extension for running PageSpeed tests from inside the browser.

entries.name: PageSpeed Insights Checker for mobile extension
entries.description: checks Mobile PageSpeed score for every page and gives you a handy preview.

entries.name: UnCSS
entries.description: removes unused CSS from pages, allowing you to reduce the global CSS you may need to load in for your site. Tasks are available for Grunt, Gulp and other build tools.
